title: Nurse Chanthasone (Vientiane District Health Center, Lao PDR)
description: Persona for J3: the nurse at Vientiane District Health Center in Lao PDR (Country B), on the clinic's tablet (OHS app, facility configuration). Goal: trust foreign records enough to avoid repeating or missing vaccines. Needs a reliable yes or no on whether a card is genuine, foreign vaccines translated to the Lao schedule, and the next doses worked out. Frustrations: unfamiliar product names from other countries; choosing between re-vaccinating and trusting paper blindly. Makes the clinical call when a foreign product has no mapping. Fictional.
